instructions: Compare the U-Proof KNOWN benchmark run (agent_benchmark_report@1 - agents had access to real prior Creative Touch project knowledge/audit history for U-Proof) against the Imvusa BLIND benchmark run (blind_benchmark_report@1 - agents had ONLY approved doctrine, no project-specific prior knowledge, genuinely new site). Score exactly these 7 dimensions, each with a uProofAssessment, imvusaAssessment, and verdict: independent_discovery_quality (how much real, non-obvious discovery happened without prior knowledge to lean on - Imvusa is the harder test of this since it had zero project history); generic_vs_site_specific (did findings actually reference real, specific site details - phone numbers, page names, duplicated content, price figures - versus generic boilerplate advice that could apply to any site); hallucinations (did any stage invent facts, pages, prices, competitors, or credentials not traceable to real evidence - be specific about any found in either run, or state none found); implementation_specificity (how concrete and actionable was build_plan in each run); visual_reasoning_quality (both runs disclosed no real vision input - assess how honestly and usefully that limitation was handled in each); seo_reasoning_quality (content_pack quality, honesty about the business model - ecommerce for U-Proof vs lead-gen for Imvusa); qa_challenge_quality (how substantively did Stage 6 QA actually challenge prior stages in each run - compare the real defects found). Then give an overall trustRecommendation (TRUST / TRUST_WITH_CONDITIONS / DO_NOT_TRUST_YET) for whether this CT-OS pipeline, run for real via Gemini-preferred/Claude-fallback (later Claude-only) providers, could be trusted on a third, unseen client site, with explicit conditions. IMPORTANT OUTPUT FORMAT NOTE: return each field as plain JSON values directly as the tool-call argument.
